mis_merges.why: Both threads are niche JPM cross-asset research that would surface as the same minor briefing card either way, so an editor's lead-theme picks wouldn't change, but the label improperly conflates a rates/credit thesis with an unrelated liquidity dataset.

notes: Fragmentation dominates: roughly a fifth of all cards sit in labels that split one underlying subject across multiple near-duplicate labels, often distinguished only by spelling/wording (e.g. 'us labour market' vs 'us labor market', 'cyclical longs' vs 'cyclicals longs'). No mis-merge was severe enough to have changed theme selection on its own.
